keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «큰 비디오 게임은 보통 수백 명이 함께하는 팀이 만든다(주제)» 와 «게임을 만들려면 창의력, 수학, 미술, 팀워크가 한꺼번에 필요하다(결론)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the topic (a big video game is usually made by a team that can include hundreds of people) and the conclusion (making games requires creativity, math, art, and teamwork all at once). The green sentences are the answers.

qs.q: Why do many games change completely while they are being made?
qs.qko: 많은 게임이 만들어지는 동안 왜 완전히 바뀌나요?
opts: Because early versions were not fun
Because players ask for louder music
evs: Many games change completely along the way because early versions were not fun.
Next comes one of the most important steps: testing.
Designers decide the story, the rules, and what makes the game fun.
Making games requires creativity, math, art, and teamwork all at once.
why: 초기 버전이 재미없었기 때문에 많은 게임이 만드는 도중에 완전히 바뀐다고 했어요.
Many games change completely along the way because early versions were not fun.

opts: the idea and plan for a game
a drawing of the main hero
a list of mistakes in the code
evs: It starts with an idea and a plan, called a game design.
Artists draw the characters, places, and objects, often with 3D computer tools.
Surprisingly, a large game can take three to five years or more to finish.
So the next time you play, remember the many people who worked together to make it.
why: 게임은 아이디어와 계획에서 시작하고, 그것을 «game design» 이라고 부른다고 했어요. 캐릭터를 그리는 것은 아티스트의 일이에요.
A game starts with an idea and a plan, called a game design. Drawing the characters is the artists’ job.

qs.q: Who most likely fixes the bugs that testers find?
qs.qko: 테스터가 찾은 버그는 누가 고칠 가능성이 가장 클까요?
opts: Programmers, because bugs are mistakes in the code they write
Sound designers, because bugs make strange noises
Artists, because bugs are drawings of insects
evs: Programmers write code, the instructions that tell the computer what to do.
Testers play the game again and again to find bugs, which are mistakes in the code.
Sound designers create music and effects, like footsteps and explosions.
Artists draw the characters, places, and objects, often with 3D computer tools.
why: 프로그래머는 코드를 쓰는 사람이고, 버그는 코드 속의 실수예요. 두 단서를 이으면 버그를 고치는 사람은 프로그래머라는 것을 알 수 있어요.
Programmers write the code, and bugs are mistakes in the code. Putting the two clues together, programmers are the ones who fix bugs.

ends: How do programmers tell a computer what to do?
프로그래머는 컴퓨터에게 할 일을 어떻게 알려 줄까?
What were the very first video games like?
맨 처음 비디오 게임은 어떤 모습이었을까?
